How to read this table: notes and sources

Each row: the machine string with its tag (pool rank, label, or its line on the list), a muted line (proofs: local proof number, the automatic checks, the PR, the family, how it was proved; others: the stage, a call or Checkpoint A questions; not started: same table as a machine we worked on, sim depth, equivalence class size, flags), the status, the sheet class (guess = the class of the nearest classified machine, ≤ 2 transitions), and when a file in its folder last changed. same table = the same transition table up to renaming states and mirroring, started in another state (428 machines in 164 groups); sim 1eN = depth simulated without halting (sheet Direct Simulation tab: 128 of the 663 not yet to 1e14); eqv ×n = machines in its equivalence class. Search: a machine string or part of one, a bbchallenge.org link, a tag (#2, R4, W4-3: exact), line 604, or a class; / focuses it. A machine's page (its name) has the picture, the mechanism, the proof and the files.
